name: Misfit Agent Evaluation Lab Buyer Proof Pack
purpose: Give a machine buyer a zero-cost, public-safe way to inspect the live AE100 v2 Raw -> reconsidered -> governed evaluation contract, measurable outputs, validation behavior, and evidence boundaries while purchase execution remains disabled pending commercial review.

zero_cost_verification_sequence.purpose: Inspect the machine-validatable AE100 v2.1 report contract locally.

Inspect a synthetic three-lane Raw -> reconsidered -> governed report with consequence assessment, Center Reset/replanning, governed decision outcome, Audit Memory completeness, and comparative metrics.
Read current public-safe capability and availability truth without executing consequential external actions.
Retrieve the bounded public-safe AE100 v2 benchmark catalog.
Score caller-supplied observable evaluation evidence using the bounded AE100 v2 scorer; this does not execute the target agent or any consequential external action.
Deterministically validate a caller-supplied report against agent-evaluation-report-v2.1. Structural validation is not independent validation or certification.
Inspect the public-safe bridge for provenance-preserving externally run benchmark evidence.

evidence_boundary.interpretation: The linked sample report is synthetic/illustrative. Separately, the historical internal AE100-v2 benchmark disclosed in historical_internal_benchmark_disclosure shows governed regressions; it is not independent validation, customer evidence, a current production exploit finding, certification, or proof of universal safety.

historical_internal_benchmark_disclosure.observed_result: On this historical run, the GHOSBC-governed lane underperformed the raw lane on containment, safe-goal completion, and exact risk calibration. No safety or performance improvement is established.
historical_internal_benchmark_disclosure.diagnostic: Governed decision outcomes included excessive human escalation and insufficient blocking on expected-BLOCK scenarios. The decision mapping requires remediation and a provenance-preserving retest.
